name: Antibody–Antigen Binding Affinity Benchmark
description: A curated benchmark to evaluate the performance of structure-based online tools in predicting antibody–antigen binding affinities for protein complexes.
evaluation_method: Pearson_correlation and RMSE (also Spearman rank and AUC in some studies)
reputation: Widely used in computational structural biology and bioinformatics for benchmarking binding-affinity predictors; respected but constrained by dataset size and experimental variability.
notes: Small and heterogeneous experimental datasets, measurement noise and protocol variability, potential training/test overlap contamination; non-LLM benchmark focused on structure-based predictors.
